name: OS-CIT
shortDescription: Build essential computer and digital literacy skills for everyday professional and personal use.
description: OS-CIT provides foundational knowledge of computers, operating systems, internet usage, digital services, productivity tools and essential workplace skills.

name: Tally with GST
shortDescription: Learn accounting fundamentals and manage business transactions using Tally with GST.
description: Learn practical accounting concepts, company management, voucher entry, taxation and GST operations using Tally software.

name: C Programming
shortDescription: Learn programming fundamentals and problem-solving using the C programming language.
description: Develop a strong programming foundation with C by learning variables, control structures, functions, arrays, pointers, structures and file handling.

name: SCRATCH Programming
shortDescription: Learn programming concepts creatively using Scratch's visual programming environment.
description: An introductory programming course designed to teach computational thinking, logic and programming concepts through interactive Scratch projects.

name: DTP CorelDraw
shortDescription: Learn desktop publishing and professional graphic design using CorelDRAW.
description: Learn to create professional layouts, illustrations, logos, brochures, posters and other print-ready designs using CorelDRAW.

name: DTP Adobe
shortDescription: Learn desktop publishing and creative design using Adobe design tools.
description: Develop practical desktop publishing skills using Adobe applications to create professional layouts, publications and marketing materials.

name: Video Editing
shortDescription: Learn professional video editing techniques for creating engaging digital content.
description: Learn the fundamentals of video editing, including cutting, transitions, audio, effects, titles and final video production.

name: Web Designing
shortDescription: Learn to design responsive and user-friendly websites using modern web technologies.
description: Learn the fundamentals of website design including HTML, CSS, layouts, responsive design and basic interactive web elements.

name: Advanced Tally
shortDescription: Advance your accounting skills with advanced Tally features and business accounting workflows.
description: Build advanced accounting and business management skills using Tally, including inventory, taxation, reports and advanced financial operations.

name: C++ Programming
shortDescription: Learn object-oriented programming and software development fundamentals using C++.
description: Master C++ programming concepts from fundamentals through object-oriented programming, data structures and practical application development.

name: Advanced Excel
shortDescription: Master advanced Excel tools, formulas, data analysis and business reporting.
description: Learn advanced spreadsheet techniques for managing, analyzing and presenting business data using Excel.

name: Adobe Photoshop
shortDescription: Learn image editing, retouching and professional graphic design using Photoshop.
description: Learn professional image editing and graphic design techniques using Adobe Photoshop, from basic tools to advanced composition.

name: AutoCAD
shortDescription: Learn computer-aided design and create accurate 2D drawings using AutoCAD.
description: Develop practical CAD skills for creating technical drawings, layouts and designs using AutoCAD.

name: IT Hardware Support
shortDescription: Learn computer hardware installation, maintenance and troubleshooting.
description: Build practical skills for identifying, installing, maintaining and troubleshooting computer hardware and peripheral devices.

name: Network Support
shortDescription: Learn computer networking concepts, configuration and troubleshooting.
description: Understand networking fundamentals and develop practical skills for configuring and troubleshooting computer networks.

name: English
shortDescription: Improve English communication, grammar, vocabulary and workplace communication skills.
description: Develop practical English language skills for professional and everyday communication through grammar, vocabulary, speaking and writing practice.

name: Content Illustrator
shortDescription: Learn to create engaging visual content and illustrations for digital and print media.
description: Develop creative design skills for producing illustrations, visual content and marketing graphics using professional design techniques.

name: Desktop Support
shortDescription: Learn to install, configure and troubleshoot desktop computers and operating systems.
description: Develop practical desktop support skills for resolving common hardware, operating system, software and user-related technical issues.

name: Smart Teacher
shortDescription: Develop digital teaching skills and learn to use technology effectively in the classroom.
description: Learn how to integrate digital tools, multimedia resources and technology-based teaching methods into modern classrooms.

name: OS-CIT A+
shortDescription: Build advanced digital and professional IT skills through the OS-CIT A+ diploma program.
description: OS-CIT A+ combines OS-CIT with three OCOC courses to provide comprehensive digital, professional and career-oriented computer skills.

name: OS-CIT A
shortDescription: Build advanced computer skills through OS-CIT combined with an OCOC career course.
description: OS-CIT A combines foundational digital literacy with an OCOC career-oriented course to provide broader professional IT skills.

name: Graphic Designing
shortDescription: Learn the principles and tools required to create professional graphic designs.
description: Develop practical graphic design skills including typography, composition, color theory, image editing and visual communication.

name: Mobile App Development
shortDescription: Learn the fundamentals of designing and developing mobile applications.
description: Understand mobile application development concepts and build practical applications using modern mobile development approaches.

name: Python Programming
shortDescription: Learn Python programming fundamentals and develop practical programming skills.
description: Learn Python from the fundamentals through functions, collections, object-oriented programming, file handling and practical projects.

name: Java Programming
shortDescription: Learn Java programming and object-oriented software development fundamentals.
description: Build a strong foundation in Java programming including object-oriented programming, exception handling, collections and practical application development.

name: Retail Management
shortDescription: Learn essential retail operations, customer service and business management skills.
description: Develop practical knowledge of retail operations, inventory, customer service, sales and day-to-day retail business management.

name: Cyber Security
shortDescription: Learn cybersecurity fundamentals, common threats and basic security practices.
description: Understand the fundamentals of cybersecurity, digital threats, safe computing practices, network security and data protection.

name: Digital Freelancing
shortDescription: Learn how to start, manage and grow a freelance career using digital platforms.
description: Learn the fundamentals of freelancing, creating a professional profile, finding projects, communicating with clients and managing freelance work.

name: Banking, Financial Services and Insurance
shortDescription: Learn fundamentals of banking, financial services and insurance operations.

name: Tally Prime with GST

description: Learn practical accounting operations using TallyPrime including company management, transactions, inventory, GST and financial reporting.

name: HTML with CSS

name: Database Management System (DBMS)

name: Social Media Marketing

description: Learn social media strategy, content planning, audience engagement, advertising fundamentals and performance measurement.

name: AI-ML Basics
shortDescription: Understand the fundamentals of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning.
description: Get introduced to artificial intelligence, machine learning concepts, common applications, data fundamentals and the role of AI in modern technology.

name: Data Analytics and Data Visualization
shortDescription: Learn how to analyze data and create meaningful visualizations for decision-making.
description: Learn data analysis fundamentals, spreadsheet-based analysis, visualization techniques and how to communicate insights effectively.

name: Advanced Tally Prime with GST
shortDescription: Master advanced accounting, GST and business reporting using TallyPrime.
description: Develop advanced TallyPrime skills covering accounting, inventory, taxation, GST compliance, financial reporting and business management.

name: Data Entry and Data Management
shortDescription: Learn accurate data entry, organization and basic data management skills.
description: Develop practical skills for entering, organizing, maintaining and managing digital data using common office and productivity tools.
